title: Maps in mall world
content: I finally saw a map!! I’m always getting lost/turned around in mall world but for the first time ever I saw a map! The strange this is I was fixated on this women standing in front of the map with her child because she has gorgeous long blonde hair. She also was wearing an outfit that was odd. Anyone else seen a map and can remember the layout of the map!?! Typically I’m looking for a bathroom stall that isn’t fucked up, looking for my dorm/room in the hotelish/resort/apartment part of the mall, wondering the food court area, going to the movies, at the gym etc
